$comment: Caller-facing rate limits of the Existing System, moved here from code on 2026-10-04 (owner R312) without changing any value. These limit how often ONE CALLER may hit OUR API; they are not provider (source) limits, which live on each catalogue record as minIntervalSec. Final figures are DECISION REQUIRED (R308); see docs/reconciliation/RATE_LIMITS_2026-10-04.md. Counters are in-memory, per running instance, fixed window.

gateway.appliesTo: every /api route except the UNLIMITED prefixes in lib/api-scope.ts (middleware.ts)
gateway.purpose: Protect the goodwill of the public providers each gateway call fans out to; one looping client must not exhaust them for everyone.

write.purpose: Writes are cheap to serve but more attractive to abuse.

signIn.purpose: Raise the cost of password guessing from one address.

signInSubject.key: hash of the identity being claimed
signInSubject.purpose: Stop one account being hammered from many addresses, while staying above signIn so typing someone's email cannot lock them out.

code.purpose: Each request can send an email; generous for a person, useless as a mail cannon.
